# Healthcare Survey Guide

> Independent directory of paid healthcare market-research panels and medical survey companies for healthcare professionals.

## Primary pages
- /index.html — Overview of paid healthcare surveys and who may participate
- /companies.html — Comparison of M3 Global Research, Sermo, All Global Circle, MDForLives, and ZoomRx
- /physicians.html — Guide for physicians, residents, and fellows
- /other-hcps.html — Guide for nurses, NPs, PAs, pharmacists, and other healthcare professionals
- /faq.html — Eligibility, screening, credential verification, compensation, privacy, and referral questions
- /about.html — Methodology, source policy, and referral disclosure

## Editorial policy
Descriptions should be verified against first-party company sources. Referral relationships are disclosed. The directory does not claim guaranteed earnings or fabricate first-hand experience.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-14
